mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a 0.25% increase in FEDFUNDS, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 0.5% rise in UNRATE, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a sustained 3-month decline in RSAFS, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals supply-side disruptions, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to potential inflationary pressures and reduced output.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 2% decline in INDPRO, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 jobs in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which typically lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a 300,000 increase in PAYEMS, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% over a 3-month period, it signals a weakening in the housing market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 10% decline in HOUST, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
regime_hint: inflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL is rising, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is stagnant or declining, it signals a demand-side slowdown with deflationary risks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and CPIAUCSL stagnant/declining
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth is < 1% QoQ and CPIAUCSL is stagnant/declining, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
